name: Belarus
shortSummary: India maintains a functional but modest relationship with Belarus, with some defence-industrial and pharmaceutical trade continuing despite Belarus's international isolation following the 2020 political crisis and its alignment with Russia.

majorChallenges.title: International isolation
majorChallenges.description: Belarus's close alignment with Russia and Western sanctions complicate deeper engagement.
